question: Durand cup is associated with which game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Durand Cup is associated with the game of football: 
 
• The Durand Cup is India's oldest football tournament and Asia's third oldest. 
 
• The first Durand Cup was held in 1888 in Annadale, Shimla. 
 
• Since 1940, the tournament has been played in New Delhi. 
 
• The Durand Football Tournament Society (DFTS) co-hosts the tournament. 
 
• The tournament was originally a football competition for the different departments and regiments of the Indian Armed Forces and the princely states. 
 
• Since independence, several clubs from different regiments of the Indian Armed Forces participate as guest invitees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey: The Rangaswamy Cup is associated with hockey.
 
 
• Other hockey cups include the Agha Khan Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy, Beighton Cup, Scindia Gold Cup, and Sultan Azlan Shah Cup. 
 
 
 
• Football: The Durand Cup, Subroto Cup, Santosh Cup, FIFA World Cup, and La Liga Cup are all associated with football.
 
 
• The Women's FA Cup is the top annual cup tournament for women's clubs in English football. 
 
 
 
• Tennis: The Davis Cup and the Grand Slam tournaments (Wimbledon, US Open, Australian Open, and French Open) are associated with tennis.
 
 
• The Billi Jean King Cup is associated with women's tennis. 
 
 
 
• Basketball: The FIBA Basketball World Cup, Eurobasket, and NBA are associated with basketball. 
 
• Golf: The Canada Cup, Ryder Cup, Walker Cup, and Eisenhower Cup are associated with golf.
 
 
• The Solheim Cup is also associated with golf. 
 
 
 
• Table tennis: The Corbillon Cup is associated with world table tennis. 
 
• Asian Cup: The Merdeka Cup is associated with the Asian Cup
